title: 第15章 抢生意的来了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “国强，”赵素梅吃完最后一块肉，放下筷子，犹豫了一下，问道，“你明天还去吗？”

    “去，明天多做二十个，卖七十个。”

    “那你一个人忙得过来吗？”

    “忙得过来，就是和面、卤肉、烙馍，都是熟活儿。”

    赵素梅沉默了一会儿，然后说：“要不……我帮你吧？”

    林国强看着她，有些意外。

    “你在家带孩子，咋帮我？”

    “我可以帮你和面、烙馍，你看，”她把手伸出来，“我这双手虽然笨，但和面还是会的。

    至于孩子，静静三岁了，可以自己在院子里玩，薇薇我来背，不耽误干活。”

    林国强想了想，摇了摇头：“不行，太累了。

    你在家带好孩子就行，外面的事我来。”

    “我不怕累。”赵素梅的声音很轻，但很坚定，“国强，我不想光在家里等着，我想帮你。

    咱们一起干，日子才能过得好。”

    林国强看着她，看了很久。

    昏暗的煤油灯下，她的眼睛亮亮的，像两颗浸了水的黑葡萄。

    那里面有一种光，是他从来没有见过的。

    不是委屈，不是忍耐，不是逆来顺受，而是一种想要跟他并肩站在一起的倔强。

    “好。”他点了点头，“那你帮我打下手，和面、切肉、烙馍，我教你。”

    赵素梅笑了，笑得眉眼弯弯，露出了两个浅浅的酒窝。

    林国强看着她笑，心里忽然涌上来一股酸涩。

    他想起了她刚嫁给自己的样子。

    扎着麻花辫，穿着碎花衬衫，站在村口的大槐树下，冲他笑。

    那时候她的笑就是这个样子的，眼睛弯弯的，酒窝浅浅的。

    后来呢？后来她就不笑了。

    生活的重担把她压得喘不过气来，她的笑容一点一点地消失，取而代之的是眉头那道越来越深的竖纹。

    今天，她又笑了。

    林国强在心里暗暗发誓。

    这辈子，他要让她一直笑下去。

    夜深了，一家四口挤在木床上。

    林国强躺在最外面，赵素梅在中间，两个孩子在最里面。

    林静已经睡着了，小手攥着林国强的衣角，怎么都不松开。

    林薇趴在赵素梅的胸口上，呼吸均匀，小肚子一起一伏的。

    赵素梅也没有睡着。

    “国强，”她轻声说，“你说咱们以后……真能过上好日子吗？”

    “能。”林国强回答得毫不犹豫。

    “你咋这么肯定？”
    第(1/3)页

"Guoqiang," Zhao Sumei finished eating the last piece of meat, put down her chopsticks, hesitated, and asked, "Are you still going tomorrow?"

"Go, make twenty more tomorrow and sell seventy."

"Can you do it alone?"

“It’s very busy, even making noodles, braised pork, and baking steamed buns are all familiar tasks.”

Zhao Sumei was silent for a while, and then said: "How about... let me help you?"

Lin Guoqiang looked at her, a little surprised.

"You are taking care of your children at home, how can you help me?"

"I can help you knead the noodles and bake the buns. Look," she stretched out her hands. "Although my hands are stupid, I can still knead the noodles."

As for the child, Jingjing is three years old and can play in the yard by herself. I will carry Weiwei on her back without delaying her work."

Lin Guoqiang thought for a while and shook his head: "No, I'm too tired.

You can just take care of your children at home, and I will take care of the outside matters."

"I'm not afraid of getting tired." Zhao Sumei's voice was soft but firm, "Guoqiang, I don't want to just wait at home, I want to help you.

We can live a good life if we work together."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her for a long time.

Under the dim kerosene lamp, her eyes were as bright as two black grapes soaked in water.

There was a kind of light in it that he had never seen before.

It’s not a grievance, it’s not patience, it’s not resignation, it’s a stubbornness that wants to stand side by side with him.

"Okay." He nodded, "Then you can help me with making noodles, cutting meat, and baking buns. I'll teach you."

Zhao Sumei smiled, her eyebrows curved, revealing two shallow dimples.

Lin Guoqiang looked at her smile, and suddenly felt a sour feeling in his heart.

He thought of how she had just married him.

Wearing braids and a floral shirt, she stood under the big locust tree at the entrance of the village and smiled at him.

Her smile looked like this at that time, with crooked eyes and shallow dimples.

What happened next?Then she stopped laughing.

The burden of life weighed her down, and her smile disappeared little by little, replaced by increasingly deep vertical lines on her brow.

Today, she smiled again.

Lin Guoqiang secretly swore in his heart.

In this life, he wants her to laugh all the time.

It was late at night, and a family of four huddled on the wooden bed.

Lin Guoqiang was lying on the outside, Zhao Sumei was in the middle, and the two children were on the inside.

Lin Jing has fallen asleep, her little hands are holding the corner of Lin Guoqiang's clothes, and she won't let go.

Lin Wei lay on Zhao Sumei's chest, breathing evenly, her belly rising and falling.

Zhao Sumei didn’t fall asleep either.

"Guoqiang," she said softly, "do you think we can really live a good life in the future?"

"Yes." Lin Guoqiang answered without hesitation.

"How can you be so sure?"
